scope: Build 685: remove two unused imports in Build 683 behavior tests to satisfy Windows Ruff F401; no runtime or user behavior changes. Companion GitHub Build Process v143 unchanged.

H1.summary: Use native full-PCM FLAC fingerprint validation before cleanup; repair corrupt keeper from proven healthy copy.

H2.summary: Treat missing FLAC STREAMINFO MD5 as unverifiable; never trigger corruption removal solely for unset checksum.

H3.summary: Archive rename/copy operation mappings durably before token-log truncation/pruning; Reverse reads archival history.

M1.summary: Human-facing prompt has no 30-second wait limit; dialog close selects Skip.

M2.summary: Lossless Rename Compliantly preflight blocks removal of date/year, location, venue, artist and source qualifiers; uncertain identification is skipped.

M3.summary: Idempotent names remain unchanged across repeated runs; punctuation-only reductions are skipped.

M4.summary: Setlist index retains exact show and path mapping without changing the two-column bootlist format.

M5.summary: Apostrophes and qualifiers search literally; explicit boolean grammar is bounded.

M6.summary: Read bootlist.csv as strict UTF-8-SIG; malformed encoding blocks update instead of dropping bytes.

M7.summary: Keep successful worker results; rerun unfinished read-only work only; fail closed on uncertain mutating paths.

M8.rationale: 36 one-character volume log tokens remain; document the limit now, and expand token scheme only with migration tests.

L1.rationale: City extraction under alternate date spellings remains a parsing improvement, not part of safety fixes.

L2.rationale: Month aliases Mars/Juli and cross-range parsing need artist-aware tests before adjusting date grammar.

L3.rationale: The TLO requirement explicitly defines duplicates by exact file names, structure and sizes, not content hashes. This is an intentional user-selected behavior; the User Manual warns of distinct equal-size recordings.

L4.rationale: Deeply nested duplicate-tree recursion needs iterative traversal and end-to-end deep path tests.

L5.rationale: Cross-device Add Shows moves need verified publication; code-read finding still requires failure-injection tests.

L6.rationale: Crash recovery for orphaned staging directories needs a dedicated journaled recovery design.

L7.rationale: Search formula escaping and expression error text require UI-focused tests before changes.

L8.rationale: The source ZIP carries an empty artists.sqlite placeholder by design. The build process injects the authoritative master before release; source-only runs require a real master.

L9.rationale: Lock-owner detail failure needs Windows-native reproduction; no unsupported Windows assumptions in this build.

L10.rationale: Low-priority code hygiene and incidental messaging are deferred to avoid touching unrelated workflows.

T1.summary: Ordinary pytest disables bytecode creation at suite initialization.

T2.summary: Add real media regressions instead of relying only on FFmpeg-return-code mocks.

T3.rationale: Aggregate and entry-point coverage gaps remain; add behavior coverage incrementally rather than enforce an arbitrary threshold.

T4.rationale: Retain existing source-text contracts for now; replace them with runtime tests as relevant areas change.
